title: Constructible subsets of an affine spectrum are finite unions of sets D(f) ∩ V(g_1,…,g_n)
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\operatorname{Spec}A$ its spectrum [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; for $f\in A$ write $D(f)=\{\mathfrak p:f\notin\mathfrak p\}$ (an open subset) and for $g_1,\dots,g_n\in A$ ($n\ge0$) write $V(g_1,\dots,g_n)=\{\mathfrak p:g_1,\dots,g_n\in\mathfrak p\}$ (a closed subset). A subset $E\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}A$ is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] if and only if it is a finite union of subsets of the form $D(f)\cap V(g_1,\dots,g_n)$ with $f,g_1,\dots,g_n\in A$ (Stacks Algebra, Lemma 0G1P).
